answer: Each identity registers one forge, locks 85 credits, and rents one karst sinkhole chamber for its slag. Its chimney carries a velvet filter pad trapping dust in proportion to output. Each epoch an auditor weighs pad and slag against output; mismatch, sharing, or reuse burns the bond. Rent starts at 36, rising 5 per earlier chamber: the kth fake pays 31+5k plus 85 at risk, and 1,000 fakes pay 2,533,500 plus 85,000 locked, no discount. A rented-chamber ring fails: pads differ across forges, one chamber shows one total. An honest smith pays 36 once and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
